text: Fabric & Real-Time Analytics's production chapter established the practices that keep a pipeline reliable. AI is a new tool inside an already-established toolkit, not a new toolkit.
Testing gets faster first drafts, still reviewed the same way. RCA gets a faster first hypothesis, still confirmed against logs and data before it's written up.
Observability is what actually produces the logs an RCA draft depends on in the first place — no logs, no useful draft.
AI drafts faster within an established practice — it doesn't decide which practices apply, how strict an SLA should be, or when an incident is actually resolved.
One more tool in an already-built toolkit, not a replacement for any part of it. Next up: the honest limits of AI in this field.
